name: Bloodfields: Front
summary: The forward warfront of the Bloodfields, where Muramite legions clash with resistance fighters.
description: The Bloodfields Front is the active battle line between Muramite forces and Dranik resistance fighters. Trenches, barricades, siege platforms, and Discord‑scarred terrain dominate the landscape. Muramite legions push forward from their camps while resistance fighters attempt sabotage and counter‑strikes. The Front is volatile, shifting daily as both sides fight for control.
